title: SEMANTIC SEE-THROUGH GOGGLES: Wearing Linguistic Virtual Reality in (Artificial) Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative observation and user interviews during a workshop study, noting the system's tendency to generate highly stereotypical gendered body types (e.g., muscular men, slender women) in a real-time image-to-text-to-image pipeline.

Qualitative observation and participant feedback showing the generative system defaults to depicting Western/white individuals, often altering the race of non-white users in the generated output (e.g., depicting an Asian man as a white person).
Analysis of subjective user interview comments reporting the automatic beautification, averaging, and stereotyping of their own faces and bodies in the AI-mediated visual output.
